selectorDescription: Choose a starting idea or bring your own. Every detail can change.
fallback: Here are a few simple questions to get you going.
memoryContributionRequired: Add at least one real detail before continuing with a memory story.
memoryContributionPlaceholder: Tell us one thing that really happened, or add it by voice or image.
modeHelp: Imagination can fill a fictional world. A memory story uses only the facts you share.
changeDescription: This will replace your current template and guided answers. Your original contribution stays available.
error: Something went wrong. Your answers are still here.
resetDescription: Start fresh on this device? This clears your current story inputs and selections. Saved stories stay in your library.
guideComplete: Your story is ready to continue
contributionHelp: Share only what you want included. We will not invent personal facts.
restructureDescription: Rebuild the outline from these details? This can replace details you edited in later steps.
structureError: We could not finish the outline. Your inputs are saved; try again.
templateUnavailable: This story idea is unavailable. Choose another or use your own.

drawing-adventure.title: A drawing comes alive
drawing-adventure.premise: A curious inventor discovers that a drawing can step off the page and join a friendly adventure.
drawing-adventure.description: Turn an imaginary drawing into a new friend.

moonlight-adventure.title: A little moonlight adventure
moonlight-adventure.premise: A curious hero and a friendly companion take a gentle journey beneath the moon, returning to a cosy place to rest.
moonlight-adventure.description: A gentle adventure for winding down.

pet-mission.title: A pet on a secret mission
pet-mission.premise: A resourceful pet discovers a small mystery and helps its friends solve it through curiosity and kindness.
pet-mission.description: Give a fictional pet a surprising adventure.

magic-doorway.title: The hidden doorway
magic-doorway.premise: A curious explorer finds an unexpected doorway and follows clues into a welcoming magical world.
magic-doorway.description: Open a door to a world of possibilities.

little-love.title: Love in the little things
little-love.premise: A story of two people, told through the little gestures and everyday objects that matter to them.

travel-memories.title: A journey worth keeping
travel-memories.premise: A journey told through discoveries, detours and moments worth keeping.
travel-memories.description: Turn a real or imagined trip into a story.

grandparent-memory.title: Stories to pass on
grandparent-memory.premise: A family story woven from the memories, sayings and details you share about a grandparent.
grandparent-memory.description: Begin with one real memory, saying or detail.

teamwork-day.title: Everyone brings something
teamwork-day.premise: A team tackles a playful challenge and discovers how different strengths help everyone contribute.
teamwork-day.description: An adventure about cooperation and belonging.
